title: Western Ghats Sunrise
project: Western Ghats Sunrise (a 60 s cue, a fusion of Carnatic, orchestral and Scottish pipe writing)
brief: A 60 second A.R. Rahman style cultural mix with his signature; the ambience of a sunrise in the Western Ghats; Scottish bagpipes joined smoothly (real pipes play fast); catchy and upbeat; the ambience quiet at the start.
audience: a listener on headphones or speakers, a travel-film or album-opener context; they know the sound of Indian film fusion
purpose: a one-minute upbeat fusion cue: a catchy syncopated bansuri riff in the Mohanam pentatonic over a rhythmic string pulse, tabla, a layered choir and a Highland piper playing a fast reel, a Western rock kit and electric guitars, in a living Western Ghats dawn
point_of_view: an observer on the ridge: the world wakes around the music, and the music gives it a voice
job: hook the listener inside six seconds with the riff and the pulse
turn the harmony up a whole tone when the sun clears the ridge and bring it home to the tonic
let a piper take the stage with a fast reel in the flute's rest
keep the ambience under the music for the first thirty seconds
story: A short mist, then the pulse starts and the riff repeats; the sun clears the ridge at 21 s, a piper answers at 30 s, the crest is at 42 s and a calm morning follows.

sections.name: mist
sections.action: mist over the valley, one far bird
sections.music: the bansuri alone over the tanpura; the tabla starts at 2 s; the riff arrives as a pickup in bar 3

sections.name: first_light
sections.music: the riff repeats on the bansuri, the violins answer it a third below, the 3+3+2 pulse, veena plucks, the pipes' drone swells in at 15 s, pp choir at 13 s

sections.name: sunrise
sections.music: a whole-tone key raise and a daf stroke; the riff up a step; the piper echoes it in canon, then plays a fast reel alone at 30 s while the flute rests; the flute returns high at 38.6 s; the choir builds from pp to ff

sections.name: morning
sections.music: back in the home key: the riff once, softly; a distant flourish on the pipes; Sa alone; the choir returns to pp

the piper far behind at 30 s
immersive.notes: Heights, trajectory keyframes and the room live in the presets; this block records the intent.

expression.sonic_picture: The first ten seconds are a bansuri over a soft tanpura and a light tabla, one far bird and a faint stream; a catchy syncopated riff repeats; by the middle a rhythmic viola pulse drives, a piper plays a fast reel on a far hill; the last note is Sa alone with the morning birds.
expression.performer: The flute breathes in the phrase gaps and the long notes warm up; the strings lean on beat one and ease the bow off before each change; the piper never stops the drone and never lifts the chanter: cuts and gracenotes separate the notes; the choir is people in sections who join as the sound grows.
expression.producer_moves: The key rises a whole tone as the sun clears the ridge and comes home; the tutti choir enters only above forte; the ambience opens out after 30 s; the mix carries section loudness from the plan.
expression.anti_generic: The generic version is a pad, a flute loop and a drum loop on a fixed key; what stops it is a syncopated riff with a leap on the weak beat, a harmonic turn and return, a fast ornamented pipe reel, and a choir that changes make-up with its dynamic.
